snippet.title: Karantiin – Build 3
snippet.description:
This is a fan-made gameplay trailer created by community member  ⁨@Lazy_Hanby⁩ for Karantiin Build 3.  
All footage is from the current development build and showcases the game’s world, mechanics, and atmosphere.

Game: Karantiin  
Build: 3  
Trailer by: @Lazy_Hanby 
Type: Fan / Community Trailer  
Music composed by: @Karantiin 

Experience the suspense, explore the survival horror, and see what Build 3 has to offer.  

Wishlist and follow the project on Itch.io: https://karantiin.itch.io/karantiin
